confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few aggregator and guide sources (Expatistan, Numbeo-derived figures, travel guides) with small or uneven sample sizes, converted at an implied EUR/USD of about 1.14 taken from an Expatistan price pair, not from an RBA or ECB rate. Restaurant meal anchors are the most reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and were partly set from local price relationships to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. FX: the official RBA exchange-rates page I could access showed a 20 March 2026 observation of 0.7088; I did not verify the RBA F11 series for a later date, and a third-party mirror listed a 27 October 2026 value of 0.7021 that I could not confirm against rba.gov.au, so the official page snapshot is used here.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon-specific basis for food and drink from local guides and cost-of-living indexes; accommodation is a holistic estimate informed by Lisbon's position as a mid-priced Western European capital with high July demand.
